contracts.authority: Apache Maven distribution layout (maven.apache.org/wrapper, the distributionUrl of .mvn/wrapper/maven-wrapper.properties): an apache-maven-<version>-bin archive and the .sha512 or .sha256 checksum file its host publishes beside it
contracts.reason: Installs the Maven release a build's Maven wrapper states: reads the checksum the archive's host publishes beside it, downloads the archive once and checks it, then hands the checked file to the pinned-archive installer through a transport that serves that one URL. The layout belongs to the Apache Maven release process and the wrapper's properties, so no Putnami provider declaration can generate this client.
